title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode8 A Finale for the Future

meta.Episode: Episode8 — A Finale for the Future
meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Now, we'll be using your magical smiles to give Phoenix Wonderland a little makeover! Let's kick off our Smiling Nighttime event!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<The night is still young!
It's showtime!>
se_event_wonders_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Hey, we should go on the Ferris wheel! I bet everything looks amazing from up there right now!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: The roller coaster's effects are different now compared to during the day! Let's check it out!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What...?
Now they're all lining up for these rides...?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I don't believe this...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (Phoenix Wonderland has always had fewer rides and attractions compared to other parks, which hindered our ticket sales...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (We even tried an illumination scheme before to try and get guests to come at night, but that didn't work out either...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (It felt like there just wasn't a good way to differentiate ourselves from the bigger parks.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (This show gave this spectacle meaning. It made our guests want to go on these rides and be a part of it all.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (By putting on these sorts of performances, we might just be able to ignite that spark and get more guests to go on these rides more...)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage troupe actually planned for all of this to happen...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, it's me. What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: What?! Pre-sale tickets have sold out for the next three months?! Even night tickets for during the week?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
“PXL” is trending at #1...?
Videos of the finale for this show are already getting millions of views...?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What?!
That show did all of that?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It seems like it...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's doing particularly well among middle and high schoolers it seems. They appear to be the ones buying up all the weeknight tickets.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Y-You can't be serious...
se_event_wonders_2021_004

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, it's almost time for us to say farewell...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah, I hate to say goodbye at a time like this, but we hope to see all your smiling faces again!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <Everyone! Thank you for coming!>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: <Thank you!!>
se_event_wonders_2021_004

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Bravo! Bravo!!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu, do you know what you've done...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Dad, Keisuke, Shosuke...
I... Um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I just couldn't give up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be “a place that makes everyone smile” forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure that as long as we try to do that, we'll get more and more guests to come and visit... Please...!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Mind if I mention something as well...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Mr. Riley...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I can honestly say this after seeing your show today.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I would absolutely love to see more of this park's sensational shows...!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: A show that involved the entire park. Others around the world have done it before, but it is quite a rare sight nonetheless.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: And I would not have been so moved if it weren't for everybody here believing in what they were doing...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: The eyes of each cast member sparkled as if to symbolize their hopes of making every single guest smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Very few people are capable of creating an amusement park that is as wonderful as this one.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: So what if we did this? Instead of recreating this park in the image of my company's characters...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Why don't we just join together and add them in?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: A thought occurred to me. I saw a future where my company's characters, my children in a way, could be a part of your park's wonderful shows.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this place will be peerless in terms of just how much joy and laughter it will be filled with...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Mr. Riley...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Of course, we can minimize any licensing fees that will be necessary. So, how does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That's...! Y-Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Father...!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: My apologies, Keisuke, Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: I was convinced that it would be inappropriate of me to express my own personal beliefs regarding this park...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: I was certain that, as the head of the Otori Group, I would have to make tough decisions and sacrifices in order to keep everything running...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line:
However...
It appears that part of me was still there...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What part of you?

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: The part that could not be happier to hear that my father's park will be able to remain as it is...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Father...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: Mr. Riley, I'd like to express my utmost gratitude for what you've done here for us today. I'm looking forward to our future endeavors...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Thank you! I as well!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
And you, Emu...
Don't think that you're off the hook just yet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: But for now... I suppose you deserve a free pass...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Thanks to your dreams, father and Keisuke seem much better now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So that means...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our show was a success.
se_event_wonders_2021_005

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Of course, you couldn't have done this without me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? You've frozen up...?
I was ready to cover my ears since you usually exclaim something ridiculous at times like these...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Is he in silent mode?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or could it be because this show's finally over?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No... I mean...
How do I put it...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
All these people...
As far as I can see, they're smiling and enjoying themselves...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's really a sight to behold.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
This really is sooo...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Hahaha!
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Yesterday's show could not have gone better! A decisive victory indeed!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's still getting a lot of buzz online too. I'm sure more and more guests will come to visit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, I didn't expect this to become known throughout the country.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe we have Emu's “Smiling Spell” to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, it was because of you guys!
Thank you so much for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also, my brothers are supposed to come and visit us today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Your brothers?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, that will be us.
Do you have some time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, we didn't expect to see you again so soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-What do you want...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: First, we'd like to express our gratitude. Thank you for putting on such a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I'd convinced myself that dreams and ideals were too frivolous to be bothered with...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you proved me wrong. I realize how great it is to be able to believe in something now.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Which is why there's something we'd like you to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something you want us to do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just what exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We want you to become ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ambassadors...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Your show has turned Wonderlands×Showtime into an overnight sensation. This new position is designed to make full use of that fame.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'd like you to keep putting on shows like the one we saw yesterday, as well as at the Wonder Stage, while also performing at venues outside of Phoenix Wonderland as its representatives.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The original plan was to have the winners of the Show Contest appear in a new commercial for the park, but that's all been washed aside now...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Instead, we'll be having you perform new shows and advertise for this park.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that means...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is our chance to have the entire country see our incredible shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we accept your offer!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold your horses. Shouldn't we hear more details first before we dive in like that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, I'm sure we'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you'll have our full support as well. Outwardly, it's for the sake of this park...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you reminded us of what Phoenix Wonderland is capable of and we want you to help us reach that potential. We promise not to disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yes, it's as Keisuke said.
We're looking forward to seeing more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we call this the end of act one and the beginning of act two...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everything ended on a high note, but it also means we still have plenty of work left to do, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright then!
Wonderlands×Showtime, on me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guh! I didn't say you could tackle me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now...
We, Wonderlands×Showtime, will be beginning our new journey as ambassadors for this park!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As we embark upon this new endeavor, we will very likely also be faced with new hurdles that we must conquer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But our goal will remain the same!
We'll be bringing joy to everyone with our shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take on these challenges and make our dream a reality!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So then, Emu, will you do the honors...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What honors?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Oh, you wanna join in too, Keisuke, Shosuke? When I say this you'll...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What? There's no way I'm doing that!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. Sure, I'll bite...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, here we go...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, Rui & Keisuke
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nooo! Why didn't you say it, Shosuke?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Are you serious?! Why would I do something like that?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
This reminds me of when we were kids, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So begins the act two of Wonderlands×Showtime's magnificent spectacle!!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: 04_wonder_ed1
